LESSON 11

Command of Quantitative Evidence

Use data from a table or graph to complete, support, or weaken a statement
用表格或图中的数据补全句子、支持或削弱观点
READ THE GRAPHICTitle, axes or columns, units, and the key: what is being measured?
READ THE TEXT’S GOALWhat exactly must the data show: an example, a claim, a contrast?
TRUE AND RELEVANTThe answer must be true to the data and match the goal of the text.

Warm-up · 热身

What does the table really say?表格到底说了什么？

Read the title, the units, and every number you use. 先看标题、单位，再看数字。

Bus riders per day (thousands)
202120222023
121514
Which statement is supported by the table?
What is it?

What is a Command of Quantitative Evidence question?

Definition

A text comes with a table or graph (bar graph, line graph). The choices describe the data. You pick the choice that correctly uses the data to do what the text needs.

配有表格或图，选项描述数据。选出“数据正确”且“符合文中需要”的那一项。

How often?

About 4 per test (6%). No calculation is needed; you only read and compare numbers.

每套约 4 题，不需要计算，只需读数和比较。

Three kinds of tasks 三类任务

TaskStem
Complete补全信息…uses data from the table to complete the statement / example / text?
Support支持观点…best describes data from the graph that support the researchers’ claim?
Weaken削弱观点…best describes data from the graph that weaken the student’s conclusion?
Reading a graphic

How to read a table or graph quickly

Look at four things

  1. Title: what is the whole graphic about?
  2. Axes / column headings: what is compared (years, regions, groups)?
  3. Units: %, number, newtons, cm per year
  4. Key / legend: which bar or line is which group?

先看标题、坐标轴或表头、单位、图例。

Then use your finger

Point to each number a choice mentions and check it. Many wrong choices name the right groups but the wrong numbers, or switch “higher” and “lower.”

逐个核对选项提到的数字，很多错误选项是数字或比较方向错了。

Two tests

Every choice must pass two tests

Test 1 · Is it true?

Check the choice against the data. If any part is false, cut it.

“Pennsylvania had more than 1,200 organic farms.” → the graph shows about 800. False.

先判断真假：与图表不符就排除。

Test 2 · Is it relevant?

Many choices are true but do not do what the text needs. Ask: does it complete this sentence, support this claim?

Claim: high-information voters vote more. “Only low-information independents were below 50%” is true, but it says nothing about high-information voters. Irrelevant.

再判断相关：数据对但不说明问题的也要排除。

Tip: do Test 2 first when the claim is precise. Decide what comparison the claim needs (which groups, which direction), then look only for that comparison. 先想清楚观点需要什么样的比较，再去选项里找。

How to approach it

Five steps for data questions

1

Glance at the graphic

Title, axes, units, key. Do not study every number yet. 先浏览图表结构。

2

Find the claim or the sentence to complete

Usually the last sentence: “…claim that…,” “For example, whereas…,” “…from 1910 to 1925 ___.” 找到观点句或要补全的句子。

3

Decide what the data must show

Which groups? Which direction (higher, lower, more than half)? Which years? 确定需要哪几组、什么方向的比较。

4

Check each choice: true?

Point to the numbers. 核对数字。

5

Check each true choice: relevant?

Only one true choice does what the text needs. 真且相关的才是答案。

Skill Builder

Read a graph before you read the choices

A teacher-made graph

Title · y-axis (vertical, 纵轴) · x-axis (horizontal, 横轴) · unit (单位)

How a good reader thinks 思考过程

1 · Title. Bike trips per day in one town, five years. 标题：一个城镇五年的日均骑行次数。

2 · Axes. x-axis = year; y-axis = number of trips. 横轴是年份，纵轴是次数。

3 · Unit. “thousands”: the 2021 bar at 9 means 9,000 trips, not 9. 单位是“千”：9 表示 9,000 次。

4 · Trend. Rose 2019→2021, dipped in 2022 (9→8), then reached its peak in 2023 (12). Overall: tripled (4→12). 趋势：先升，2022 略降，2023 达到最高；总体变为三倍。

5 · Then the claim. Only now read the sentence and ask which comparison it needs. 读懂图后，再看文字需要哪种比较。

Skill Builder

Words for trends and comparisons, and how data choices trick you

Data words 数据词汇

Word中文Bike graph
increase / rise ↔ decrease / decline上升 ↔ 下降2019→2021 ↑, 2021→2022 ↓
remain stable · fluctuate保持稳定 · 波动up, down, up = fluctuate
peak · exceed峰值 · 超过peak in 2023; 2023 exceeds 2021
three times as many三倍12 = 3 × 4
majority多数 (超过一半)more than 50%
proportion / percentage比例 / 百分比part ÷ whole

Data traps 读图陷阱

❌ Wrong unit: “9 trips per day in 2021.”单位看错：应为 9,000 次。

❌ Number ≠ percent: a group with more people is not always a larger percentage.数量不等于比例。

❌ Taller ≠ better: if the bar shows days needed to ripen, a taller bar means slower.柱子高不一定代表“好”，要看纵轴测的是什么。

❌ True but irrelevant: correct numbers about the wrong group or year.数据真，但比较对象错。

❌ Half true: one part right, one part wrong.一半对一半错，整体就是错。

Skill Builder

Think aloud: true? then relevant?

Mini passage (teacher-written)

Percentage of Seeds That Sprouted

LightSpecies ASpecies B
Full sun85%80%
Partial shade60%78%
Full shade20%75%

A student grew seeds of two wildflower species under three light conditions. She claims that Species B, unlike Species A, sprouts well even in shade. ______

A) Species A had a higher sprout rate in full sun than Species B did.

B) Species B’s sprout rate stayed between 75% and 80% in all conditions, while Species A’s fell from 85% to 20%.

C) Both species sprouted best in full shade.

D) Species B sprouted at 75% in full sun.

How a good reader thinks 思考过程

1 · What must the data show? Two groups (A vs. B) and the shade rows: B stays high in shade, A drops. 需要比较 A、B 两组在阴影条件下的表现。

2 · Test 1: true? C ✗ (both are lowest in full shade). D ✗ (B in full sun = 80%, not 75%). C、D 与数据不符，排除。

3 · Test 2: relevant? A is true (85 > 80) but talks only about full sun: it says nothing about shade. ✗ A 数据正确，但只讲全日照，与“阴影”无关。

4 · Answer B. True numbers + the exact contrast the claim needs (B steady, A falls). B 既真实又正好完成观点需要的对比。

Quick Check

Quick check · Read the bike graph and the seed table小练习：先自己判断，再点开看答案

1.Bike graph: how many trips per day were there in 2020?
About 6,000 (the unit is thousands). 单位是“千”。
2.Bike graph: true or false? “Trips increased every year from 2019 to 2023.”
False: trips dipped from 9,000 (2021) to 8,000 (2022). 2022 年有下降，并非每年上升。
3.Bike graph: in which year did trips peak?
2023 (12,000). 2023 年最高。
4.Bike graph: “Trips in 2023 were about three times trips in 2019.” True?
True: 12,000 ÷ 4,000 = 3. 12 ÷ 4 = 3，正确。
5.Seed table: which species did worse in full sun?
Species B (80% < 85%). A small difference, but B is lower. 全日照下 B 较低。
6.Seed table: claim “Shade hurts Species A much more than Species B.” Which rows do you compare?
Full sun vs. full shade for both species: A drops 65 points (85→20), B drops only 5 (80→75). 比较两个物种从全日照到全阴的变化。
Worked Example

Step 1 · Read the text and the question先读短文，再读题目在问什么

What is the question asking?

The text says that in some regions, female farmers “even constituted the majority of farmers who cultivated” certain crops, “for instance, ___.” We need an example from the graph of a crop where women are more than 50%.

需要一个例子：某地区某作物中女性超过一半。

Worked Example

Step 2 · Find the evidence in the text回到短文，找到依据

1

Read the graph

Bars show the percentage of farmers who are female, by crop type (cereals, root crops, non–root vegetables) and region (north, central, south Ondo).

2

What the example needs

“the majority” = more than 50% women for a specific crop in some region.

3

Find the bars above 50%

Non–root vegetables: about 57% in north Ondo and about 54% in south Ondo. Cereals in the south: only about 35%.

4

Match

Look for the choice that names non–root vegetables in the north and south.

Worked Example

Step 3 · Test every choice逐个检验选项

A
CUT ✗
Half false: women are the majority for non–root vegetables in the south, but only about 35% for cereals.
B
CUT ✗
False (central cereals ≈ 36% > root crops ≈ 20%), and no group in central Ondo is above 50%.
C
KEEP ✓
True (≈57% and ≈54%) and relevant: both are more than half, so women are the majority.
D
CUT ✗
May be roughly true, but “a relatively equal proportion” does not show any majority. Irrelevant.

Answer: C. The key word was majority: the example needed a bar above 50%. D shows how a choice can be roughly true and still not do the job. 关键词 majority：要找超过 50% 的柱子。

Worked Example 2

Form 6 · Module 1 · Question 11分步引导：先思考，再点击显示下一步

1

Read the question · 读题

“Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?” → task = complete; the choice must be true and fit the sentence. 补全句子：选项要与表格一致，并接得上原句。

2

Locate the data · 读表找数据

The sentence covers 1910 to 1925. The table has two columns: cars produced and number of companies. Read the first row (1910) and the last row (1925) of both columns. 句子说的是 1910 到 1925 年：看两列的第一行和最后一行。

3

Predict · 预测

Cars: 123,990 → 3,185,881 = went up. Companies: 320 → 80 = went down. Prediction: “cars increased, companies decreased.” 预测：产量上升，公司数量下降。

4

Compare with the choices · 对比选项

Every choice has two parts; both must be true. A: cars increased ✓ + companies decreased ✓. 每个选项有两部分，两部分都要对；A 完全符合。

5

Eliminate the other choices · 排除错误选项

B ✗ False: both numbers changed a lot.
C ✗ False: production increased, and the number of companies did not stay the same.
D ✗ Half false: production increased, but companies decreased.

Answer: A. Cars produced: 123,990 (1910) → 3,185,881 (1925): increased. Companies: 320 → 80: decreased. → “the number of cars produced increased but the number of companies producing cars decreased.” 汽车产量上升，公司数量下降。

Worked Example 3

Form 4 · Module 1 · Question 13分步引导：先思考，再点击显示下一步

1

Read the question · 读题

“…uses data from the graph to complete the text?” → we need a statement that is true for the graph and fits after “California had between 2,600 and 2,800 organic farms and ___.” 补全句子：只需找出一个与图一致的陈述。

2

Locate the data · 读图找数据

Title: US states with the most organic farms (2016). Each bar = one state; the vertical axis = number of organic farms, with a gridline every 200. 每根柱子代表一个州；纵轴是有机农场数量，每格 200。

3

Predict · 预测

Any choice could fit grammatically, so this is a pure Test 1 (true?) question. Check each state’s bar against the range in the choice. 语法都通顺，所以只需逐个核对数值真假。

4

Compare with the choices · 对比选项

Washington’s bar ends between 600 and 800 ✓. New York (1,000–1,200), Iowa (600–800), Pennsylvania (about 800) do not match their choices. → A. 只有华盛顿州的范围正确。

5

Eliminate the other choices · 排除错误选项

B ✗ False: New York had between 1,000 and 1,200.
C ✗ Half false: Wisconsin fits, but Iowa had only 600–800.
D ✗ False: Pennsylvania had about 800.

Answer: A. This is a “complete the text” question: any true statement about another state fits. Check each bar: Washington is between 600 and 800 ✓. New York is 1,000–1,200 (not fewer than 800); Iowa is 600–800 (not 1,200–1,400); Pennsylvania is about 800 (not more than 1,200). 逐个核对柱子的数值，只有华盛顿州的范围正确。

Worked Example 4

Form 1 · Module 1 · Question 15分步引导：先思考，再点击显示下一步

1

Read the question · 读题

“Which choice best describes data from the table that support the researchers’ claim?” → find the claim first; the data must be true and support it. 任务：用数据支持观点。

2

Locate & paraphrase · 找关键句

Random placement → only about 15% of plants in patches. The claim: juvenile plants grow in patches more than chance would predict (being near other plants helps them). 随机分布只有约 15% 在植被斑块中；观点：实际比例高于随机。

3

Predict · 预测

Look at the last column (percent in patches): 59.1, 59.1, 52.7, 59.6, 52.2 → all far above 15%. Prediction: “for every species, much higher than 15%.” 最后一列都在 52%–60%，远高于 15%。

4

Compare with the choices · 对比选项

D says each species’ percentage was “substantially higher than what would be expected if plants were randomly distributed.” True + it makes the key comparison with 15%. D 真实，并且完成了与 15% 的关键比较。

5

Eliminate the other choices · 排除错误选项

A ✗ True (all are below 75%), but it does not compare with the 15% expected by chance, so it does not support the claim.
B ✗ False: H. stoechas has only 12 plants in patches; H. squamatum has the most (321).
C ✗ False: their 59.1% is much higher than the random 15%.

Answer: D. The text: if plants were random, only about 15% would be in patches. The table: every species has 52–60% in patches. Far above random → growing near other plants gives an advantage. D makes exactly this comparison for each species. 随机应为约 15%，实际五个物种都在 52%–60% → 远高于随机，支持观点。

Wrong answers

How wrong data choices are built

False data

Wrong number, wrong group, or “higher” and “lower” switched.

数据错误。

True but irrelevant

Accurate, but about only one group, or a comparison the claim does not need. The most common trap.

数据正确但与观点无关，最常见。

Half true

Two parts joined by and / but: one part right, one wrong (Wisconsin ✓, Iowa ✗).

一半对一半错。

Not in the graphic

Claims the graph cannot show: individual participants, numbers of people, causes.

图表里根本没有的信息。

Trap clinic · 陷阱诊所

Trap lab · 给错误选项贴标签每个选项都是错的：它属于哪一类陷阱？

Each choice below fails. Why?

A researcher claims that reading for fun becomes less common as students get older.
GradeStudents surveyedRead for fun at least weekly
640062%
935045%
1230031%
Which choice uses data from the table to support the claim?
162% of 6th graders read for fun at least weekly.
2Reading for fun rose from Grade 9 to Grade 12.
345% of 9th graders read weekly, and 12th graders read more often than 9th graders.
412th graders read less because they have more homework.
5Fewer 12th graders than 6th graders were surveyed.
6Most 12th graders read for fun every day.
看正确答案 · Correct answerThe share who read for fun weekly falls from 62% (Grade 6) to 45% (Grade 9) to 31% (Grade 12).
Common mistakes · 常见错误

Common mistakes这节课最容易犯的错

Skipping the title, axes, and units.
Read the title, axes, units, and key first.
点击翻面 · click to flip
Picking any true statement about the graph.
The answer must be true AND relevant to the claim.
点击翻面 · click to flip
Treating a number as a percentage.
A bigger group is not a bigger percent.
点击翻面 · click to flip
Checking only one half of an “and” choice.
Both halves must be true. Half true = false.
点击翻面 · click to flip
先让学生说“为什么错”，再翻面。
Summary

What to remember about data questions图表证据要点

01 · 识别题干

Stems: …uses data from the table / graph to complete / support / weaken… About 4 per test; no calculation.

02 · 读图顺序

Read the title, axes or columns, units, and key first.

03 · 明确数据需求

Find exactly what the text needs: which groups, which direction, which years; watch words like majority, entirely, each.

04 · 双重标准

Every answer must be true to the data and relevant to the claim.

05 · 常见陷阱

Traps: false numbers, true but irrelevant, half true, information the graphic does not contain.

06 · 30 秒自检

What does the question ask? Which words support your answer? Why does one tempting choice fail?

识别任务 → 指出原文依据 → 排除一个易错选项。
